entity-blobcount-sankey.title: Entity to blob count
entity-blobcount-sankey.description: Block counts per (proposing entity, blob count) pair.

entity-relay-sankey.title: Entity to relay
entity-relay-sankey.description: Block flow from proposing entities to relays.

entity-relay-blobcount-sankey.title: Entity through relay to blob count
entity-relay-blobcount-sankey.description: Three-column flow: proposing entity through relay to blob count bucket.

relay-blobcount-sankey.title: Relay to blob count
relay-blobcount-sankey.description: Block counts per (relay, blob count) pair.

blob-count-stacked-epoch.title: Blobs per slot by epoch
blob-count-stacked-epoch.description: Stacked bar chart of slot counts per epoch, broken down by blob-count bucket.

blob-density-scatter.title: Blobs per slot
blob-density-scatter.description: Scatter plot of blob count per slot over the day, colored by blob count.

blob-popularity-heatmap.title: Blob count popularity heatmap
blob-popularity-heatmap.description: Heatmap of how often each blob-count value (0-9) appears, bucketed by epoch.

blob-slot-heatmap-facet.title: Blob count by slot-in-epoch (faceted)
blob-slot-heatmap-facet.description: Four-panel heatmap splitting the day into contiguous epoch windows for detail.

blob-slot-heatmap-vertical.title: Blob count by slot-in-epoch
blob-slot-heatmap-vertical.description: Heatmap of blob count per slot, with slot position within epoch on the y-axis.

block-to-column-boxplot.title: Block-to-last-column spread by blob count (MEV vs local)
block-to-column-boxplot.description: Boxplot of per-slot spread between block arrival and last column seen, grouped by blob count bucket and MEV vs local.

block-to-column-histogram.title: Block-to-last-column spread histogram (MEV vs local)
block-to-column-histogram.description: Distribution of per-slot spread between block arrival and last column seen, split by MEV vs local block. 60 bins over 0-2000 ms.

column-spread-boxplot-blob.title: Block-to-last-column spread by blob count
column-spread-boxplot-blob.description: Boxplot of per-slot spread between block arrival and last column seen, grouped by blob count bucket (MEV and local combined).

block-to-column-timeseries.title: Block-to-last-column spread over time
block-to-column-timeseries.description: Per-slot spread between block arrival and last column seen, plotted over the day. Points are colored by blob count.

building-vs-network-stacked.title: Building time vs network propagation by size bucket
building-vs-network-stacked.description: Horizontal stacked bar showing mean building phase vs mean network propagation latency, grouped by wire-size bucket.

compression-ratio-scatter.title: Block compression ratio vs wire size
compression-ratio-scatter.description: Scatter of compression ratio (compressed/uncompressed) versus wire size in bytes. Includes a 1:1 reference line and an OLS regression line.

corrected-by-sizebucket-box.title: Size-corrected latency by wire-size bucket
corrected-by-sizebucket-box.description: Horizontal grouped boxplot of size-corrected propagation latency, one box per wire-size bucket.

corrected-density-by-builder.title: Size-corrected latency density (MEV vs local)
corrected-density-by-builder.description: Two 2D density heatmaps (MEV and local) showing the joint distribution of wire size and size-corrected latency.

corrected-vs-size-scatter.title: Size-corrected latency vs wire size
corrected-vs-size-scatter.description: Per-slot scatter of size-corrected propagation latency versus wire size in bytes.

double-outlier-quadrant-scatter.title: Double-outlier quadrant: large and slow blocks
double-outlier-quadrant-scatter.description: Scatter of propagation latency vs wire size with p95 threshold lines defining four quadrants. Points in the top-right quadrant are both large and slow.

entity-anomaly-rate-bar.title: Anomaly rate by entity
entity-anomaly-rate-bar.description: Horizontal bar chart ranking entities by the fraction of their slots in the double-outlier quadrant (large and slow). The mark line shows the population average anomaly rate.

entity-percentile-bars.title: Propagation latency percentiles by entity
entity-percentile-bars.description: Bar chart of p50/p95/p99 propagation latency per entity, with individual slot observations as scatter overlay.

raw-vs-corrected-box.title: Raw vs size-corrected propagation latency
raw-vs-corrected-box.description: Side-by-side boxplot comparing raw block propagation latency to size-corrected latency across all slots.

region-size-heatmap-subplots.title: Region x size median latency heatmaps
region-size-heatmap-subplots.description: Two heatmaps (sentry and contributoor) showing median propagation latency by region (rows) and wire-size bucket (columns).

region-winner-grouped-bar.title: Median block propagation latency by region
region-winner-grouped-bar.description: Median block propagation latency per region, split by observation source (sentry vs contributoor).

regional-cdf-subplots.title: Regional CDF subplots by source and size bucket
regional-cdf-subplots.description: CDF of block propagation latency in a 4x2 grid (4 regions x 2 sources). Each subplot shows one line per wire-size bucket.

regional-corrected-box.title: Size-corrected latency by region
regional-corrected-box.description: Boxplot of size-corrected propagation latency grouped by region, surfacing geographic routing asymmetries.

size-dist-histogram.title: Block wire-size distribution (MEV vs local)
size-dist-histogram.description: Overlaid histogram of block wire sizes in 100 KB bins, split by MEV and local builder types.

size-residuals-scatter.title: Propagation latency residuals from size regression
size-residuals-scatter.description: Scatter of residuals from a linear regression of propagation latency on wire size. Points above zero are slower than the model predicts.

spread-by-size-box.title: Propagation spread by wire-size bucket
spread-by-size-box.description: Horizontal boxplots of per-slot propagation spread (max observer minus min observer latency), grouped by wire-size bucket.

spread-vs-size-scatter.title: Propagation spread vs wire size
spread-vs-size-scatter.description: Per-slot scatter of propagation spread (max minus min observer latency) versus wire size in bytes.

top-entity-density-facets.title: Block density facets by top entity
top-entity-density-facets.description: Grid of 2D density heatmaps (up to 10), one per top entity by slot count, showing wire size vs propagation latency.

winning-bid-histogram.title: Winning bid value distribution
winning-bid-histogram.description: Histogram of winning bid values (ETH) binned in equal-width intervals across the observed range.

column-delta-heatmap.title: Column delta heatmap
column-delta-heatmap.description: Per-bucket delta from each column's minimum median_ms across all buckets.

column-first-seen-heatmap.title: Column first-seen heatmap
column-first-seen-heatmap.description: Median first-seen ms per column per 5-minute bucket.

column-missing-heatmap.title: Column missing-observation heatmap
column-missing-heatmap.description: Boolean flag per (column, bucket): 1 means at least one slot in that bucket had no observation for that column.

column-normalized-heatmap.title: Column normalized heatmap
column-normalized-heatmap.description: Per-column min-max normalization of median_ms; 0 is the column's fastest bucket, 1 the slowest.

column-spread-histogram.title: Column spread histogram
column-spread-histogram.description: Distribution of per-slot column spread (max minus min first-seen ms across 128 columns), binned into 60 buckets.

column-spread-timeseries.title: Column spread over time
column-spread-timeseries.description: Per-slot column spread (max minus min first-seen ms across 128 columns) plotted over the day.

age-histogram-facets.title: Mempool age distribution by transaction type
age-histogram-facets.description: Bar histogram of mempool age (ms before inclusion) per transaction type, using log-scale time buckets.

age-percentile-lines.title: Mempool age percentiles by transaction type
age-percentile-lines.description: P50/P75/P90/P95/P99 of mempool age (ms) per transaction type, for transactions seen before inclusion.

coverage-heatmap.title: Mempool coverage heatmap (tx type × hour)
coverage-heatmap.description: Heatmap of mempool coverage fraction across 5 transaction types and 24 hours of the day.

coverage-stacked-bar.title: Mempool coverage by transaction type
coverage-stacked-bar.description: Stacked bar showing before/after/never mempool visibility counts per transaction type.

delay-histogram-facets.title: Post-inclusion delay distribution by transaction type
delay-histogram-facets.description: Bar histogram of post-inclusion delay (ms after inclusion) per transaction type, using log-scale time buckets.

delay-percentile-lines.title: Post-inclusion delay percentiles by transaction type
delay-percentile-lines.description: P50/P75/P90/P95/P99 of post-inclusion delay (ms) per transaction type, for transactions seen after inclusion.

hourly-coverage-lines.title: Hourly mempool coverage
hourly-coverage-lines.description: Fraction of transactions seen in the mempool before block inclusion, per hour per tx type.

sentry-coverage-bar.title: Mempool coverage per sentry (top 15)
sentry-coverage-bar.description: Horizontal bar chart showing the top 15 Xatu sentry nodes by mempool coverage percentage.

tx-volume-stacked-time.title: Transaction volume by visibility and hour
tx-volume-stacked-time.description: Hourly transaction totals stacked by mempool visibility (before/after/never).

bid-timing-density-facets.title: Bid timing density by blob count
bid-timing-density-facets.description: 2D density heatmap of winning bid vs block arrival latency, one grid per blob count bucket.

bid-timing-density-outliers.title: Bid timing density with P95 outliers
bid-timing-density-outliers.description: Heatmap of winning bid vs block arrival latency with P95 outliers overlaid as scatter points.

bid-to-block-scatter-median.title: Bid-to-block scatter with medians
bid-to-block-scatter-median.description: Scatter of winning bid vs block arrival latency with median lines per blob count.

bid-trace-coverage-stacked.title: Bid trace coverage by relay
bid-trace-coverage-stacked.description: Horizontal stacked bar showing winning vs non-winning bid counts per relay.

bid-value-vs-block.title: Bid value vs block arrival
bid-value-vs-block.description: Winning bid value (ETH, log scale) vs block first-seen latency (ms), colored by blob count.

bid-vs-block-scatter.title: Winning bid vs first-seen
bid-vs-block-scatter.description: Per-slot comparison of winning bid latency (ms) to block arrival latency (ms), colored by blob count.

bidding-duration-vs-block.title: Bidding duration vs block arrival
bidding-duration-vs-block.description: Scatter of bidding window duration (winning bid ms minus earliest bid received ms) vs block first-seen latency.

blocks-by-blobcount-mev-local.title: Block arrival latency: MEV vs local
blocks-by-blobcount-mev-local.description: Horizontal grouped boxplots of block arrival latency split by MEV vs local builder, per blob count.

builder-density-facets.title: Builder density facets
builder-density-facets.description: 2D density heatmap of winning bid vs block arrival latency, one grid per top builder (up to 9).

first-col-by-blob-mev-local.title: First column seen: MEV vs local
first-col-by-blob-mev-local.description: Horizontal grouped boxplots of first column seen latency split by MEV vs local builder, per blob count.

last-col-by-blob-mev-local.title: Last column seen: MEV vs local
last-col-by-blob-mev-local.description: Horizontal grouped boxplots of last column seen latency split by MEV vs local builder, per blob count.

relay-box-by-blobbin.title: Block arrival latency by relay and blob count
relay-box-by-blobbin.description: Grouped boxplots of block first-seen latency per relay, broken out by blob count bucket.

relay-density-facets.title: Relay density facets
relay-density-facets.description: 2D density heatmap of winning bid vs block arrival latency, one grid per relay (up to 9).

missed-slots-by-entity-bar.title: Missed slots by entity
missed-slots-by-entity-bar.description: Top 15 entities ranked by missed-slot count for the selected day. An entity misses a slot when it submitted a bid but no block arrival was observed.

missed-slots-hourly-bar.title: Missed slots per hour
missed-slots-hourly-bar.description: Count of missed slots grouped by UTC hour. A slot is missed when it appears in bid events but has no block arrival event.

entity-miss-rate-bar.title: Entity miss rate
entity-miss-rate-bar.description: Percentage of bid slots that had no corresponding block arrival, per entity. Entities with fewer than 5 bids are excluded. Color encodes miss rate severity.

missed-slots-timeline-scatter.title: Missed slots timeline
missed-slots-timeline-scatter.description: Strip plot of missed slots along the time axis. Each cross marks a slot where a bid was observed but no block arrival occurred. Clusters indicate periods of elevated miss activity.

anomalies-by-blobcount-bar.title: Anomalous blocks by blob count
anomalies-by-blobcount-bar.description: Anomaly count per blob-count bucket (0-9). Shows whether the anomaly rate rises uniformly with blob count or whether certain blob counts produce disproportionately many outliers.

anomalies-by-builder-bar.title: Anomalous blocks by builder
anomalies-by-builder-bar.description: Top 15 builders ranked by count of propagation anomalies (block arrival latency exceeding P95 for its blob-count bucket).

anomalies-by-proposer-bar.title: Anomalous blocks by proposer
anomalies-by-proposer-bar.description: Top 15 proposers ranked by count of propagation anomalies (block arrival latency exceeding P95 for its blob-count bucket).

anomalies-by-relay-bar.title: Anomalous blocks by relay
anomalies-by-relay-bar.description: Top 15 relays ranked by count of propagation anomalies (block arrival latency exceeding P95 for its blob-count bucket).

anomaly-regression-scatter.title: Block arrival latency: anomaly scatter
anomaly-regression-scatter.description: Block arrival latency vs blob count. Anomalies (above P95 for their blob-count bucket) are highlighted. Regression line fitted through normal events only.
